sources.support: Safeguarding preparation and ATC procedures are distinct. Safeguarding is confirmed before LVP begins and may remain after LVP cancellation. Cancellation of safeguarding is separate. Remote holding has additional approval requirements; this demonstration parks at an apron instead.

clockAndWireReview.legacyProfiles: Version-one rain/snow/dusk frame values preserved; clear omits environment as before.
clockAndWireReview.fog: Version-two fogExtinctionPerMetre field; finite bounded coefficient; no precipitation for fog.
clockAndWireReview.timing: Interpolation reads replay.Clock.Time; no wall-time weather motion. Same authored curve in normal/accelerated modes and retry.

rendererReview.model: Camera-local opaque radial distance pass plus exponential attenuation composition. Source scene expands kilometre coordinates by 1000 into metre world units.
rendererReview.resources: Depth target resizes with camera, command buffer/material/target released on zero strength, condition change, clear, disable, destroy and rebind.
rendererReview.lighting: Fog does not mutate global fog, camera depthTextureMode, shared ambient or sun; prior rain/dusk lighting is restored before entering fog.
rendererReview.worldAndUi: Composition affects Standard and opaque unlit scene imagery; ScreenSpaceOverlay UI renders afterward.
rendererReview.remainingApproximation: Transparent world pixels use the opaque distance behind them. Transparent canopy and detached transparent labels therefore lack independent volumetric depth; this is an authored visual approximation.
rendererReview.performanceBoundary: Per-frame renderer enumeration and extra opaque pass require native runtime observation; no native performance claim made.
